resources.string: Owner-only, read-only provider view. Choose the actual node and provider session. Scheduled jobs are not linked to an archive here.
Choose a node for its archive
Choose the provider session you want to inspect. Upload dates are not session start times.
Provider metadata includes at most %1$d recent run summaries per job. Those summaries are not the full conversation archive.
No nodes or scheduled jobs were returned for this account.
No authoritative provider-session link is available for this job. Select a session explicitly from its node archive.

Only previously retained visible text is available. Capture completeness is unknown; the provider retains session archives for 90 days. Missing, pruned, overwritten or never-uploaded records cannot be reconstructed. Attachments and hidden reasoning are not included.
No retained records were returned. This does not establish an empty or complete conversation.
End of the currently returned archive. Refresh rescans for late uploads; capture completeness remains unknown.
Owner access could not be verified. Loaded provider content was cleared and requests stopped. Sign in with an authorized owner account to try again.
The archive changed while it was being read. Rescan from the beginning to obtain a consistent view.
An archive object is missing or expired. This view is incomplete. Rescan from the beginning; a completed rescan removes records no longer returned by the provider.
The provider rejected an archive object above its supported size. This view is incomplete.
The provider could not decode an archive object. This view is incomplete.
The Ghost history service is unavailable or not connected to this server. No new capture or upload has been enabled.
Provider history could not be read. Loaded text is kept. Retry with Refresh; do not treat this as complete history.
